caption: The drawing features a jewelry box with a wavy, ornate exterior outline and an open hinged lid, displayed in a three-dimensional perspective. The jewelry box is divided internally into several rectangular compartments, including a smaller, divided section labeled “L&S Music.” The front of the box shows a keyhole and a knob or handle. To the upper left of the box, there is a circular inset detail labeled "Screwless Hinge" which shows a cross-sectional view of a hinge inserted into a slot in both the lid and box, with an arrow pointing to the hinge and the accompanying description “Hinges inserted in slot in both lid & box and glued.” The drawing has a beige background, and all lines and text are rendered in black ink. There is a simple “Scale of Inches” ruler at the bottom right corner of the drawing, numbered from 0 to 3 inches.
title: Game Box (For Poker Chips)
